abstract: Murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells were characterized with respect to their ability to metabolize the polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon, benzo(a)pyrene [B(a)P]. The extent of metabolic activation varied more than 100-fold among the teratocarcinoma-derived cell lines examined. This difference in metabolic activity was correlated with an increase in the formation of specific metabolites that were identified by high-pressure liquid chromatography. Maximal in vitro formation of water-soluble products occurred 24 hr after the addition of [3H]B(a)P to the EC cells. Long-term incubation of EC cells with [3H]B(a)P indicated that, within the initial 24 hr, 2.3% of the input had been taken up by the cells. Subcellular analysis of the distribution of radioactivity indicated that 70 to 80% of intracellular radioactivity was associated with isolated nuclei. Therefore, the intranuclear metabolites of B(a)P were also analyzed by high-pressure liquid chromatography. Embryonal carcinoma cell lines OC15S1 and C86S1 showed significant in vitro toxic effects to B(a)P over a concentration range of 0.05 to 0.3 microgram/ml, whereas F9 and PC13 were resistant to concentrations of B(a)P up to 5 microgram/ml. Equally resistant to B(a)P was the PYS cell line, a differentiated cell type derived from EC cells. Cytotoxicity was related to the extent of metabolic activation of parent compound.
abstract_ja: マウス胎児性癌(EC)細胞を、多環芳香族炭化水素であるベンゾ(a)ピレン[B(a)P]を代謝する能力について検討した。テラトカルチノーマ由来の細胞株間で、代謝活性化の程度は100倍以上異なった。この代謝活性の差は、高速液体クロマトグラフィーで同定された特定の代謝産物の生成増加と相関していた。水溶性生成物の最大のin vitro生成は、EC細胞に[3H]B(a)Pを添加してから24時間後に生じた。[3H]B(a)Pとの長期インキュベーションでは、初期24時間以内に投入量の2.3%が細胞に取り込まれた。放射能の細胞内分布の細胞分画分析では、細胞内放射能の70～80%が単離核に関連していた。そのため、B(a)Pの核内代謝物も高速液体クロマトグラフィーで分析した。EC細胞株OC15S1とC86S1は、0.05～0.3μg/mlの濃度範囲でB(a)Pに対し有意なin vitro毒性を示した一方、F9とPC13は5μg/mlまでのB(a)P濃度に耐性を示した。同様にB(a)Pに耐性を示したのは、EC細胞に由来する分化細胞であるPYS細胞株であった。細胞毒性は、親化合物の代謝活性化の程度と関連していた。
